title: Other Camp
imageAlt: Camp reference image for the Other Camp
summary: A later location that reveals The Camp is part of a wider pattern.
intro: The Other Camp is a failed, abandoned, or duplicate settlement that mirrors The Camp and warns the Player that their hub is not unique.

details.label: Associated mystery
details.value: Repeated rules, copied routines, failed settlement, Fiona's records

details.label: Story role
details.value: Shows what happens when the camp pattern breaks

facts: The Other Camp resembles The Camp enough to feel intentional.
It contains evidence that humans and almost-humans once lived together.
Its failure makes the Player reconsider whether their own camp is stable.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Other Camp appears as an abandoned settlement, a duplicate hub, or a collapsed test site. It mirrors details from The Camp in a way that makes the Player uncomfortable.
Fiona guides the Player toward it through the old neighborhood, recording details on a phone that does not work normally. Her name appears inside the camp records before the player understands why.
This location proves that The Camp is not an accident. Its rules, stations, and routines belong to a larger system connected to Omni.
The Player finds evidence that trust failed here before it fails at their own camp.
items: Clue: names matching Frank, Greg, Fiona, and current Camp Residents.
Story effect: Ali and Amy can no longer pretend The Camp is unique.
